verdicts.reason: Both have the same layout and the same faults. The symptom list is garbled: 'Shortness of breath Dry / cough' wraps mid-item and 'Sore throat Headache' merges two symptoms on one line, so you can't count the six. The doctor illustration is cropped flat at the bottom. The CTA is small yellow text squeezed against the bottom edge, and the sparkle floats on its own. A is slightly more coherent because its hashtag badge is left-aligned on the same edge as the headline and list. B centres a small hashtag pill over left-aligned text, which keeps the original's centred bar but breaks the grid.
